sources.name: Atlas loader control rig — obs (synthetic)
sources.content:
SYNTHETIC DEMO FIXTURE. Invented bench data only; no real hardware, patient, vehicle, flight, certification, qualification or release approval.

Atlas loader control rig: J12 connects the controller to the sensor harness in a loader control-harness rig.
Operator note: an intermittent link interruption was reported during mechanical shock.
This observation alone does not establish a cause or suitability for operational use.
No mechanical shock test record accompanies this note.
Baseline revision and J12 pin mapping are not recorded.
Independent review is pending.
